The 40.64 mm span and 15.24 mm height make every U10/U11 stage-to-stage and feedback wire longer and push the pass FET/2N7002 parts further away than they need to be.

expressibility.note: This design carries the most load-bearing facts. RRI at the inputs matters on this board: the SLAU502 high-side sources run stage-2 inputs near VRES.
